fields.summary: Autonomous plan run of a bug request; no owner, no questions raised. Research: stepRunner.Handback (internal/api/run.go) resumes an ended session through resumeSession, which clears the record's whole Status, but messages a live session through messageSession and leaves Status.Done (the first visit's rhiza session done mark) in place. AgentStatus then reports SaidDone for the rejoined visit, so a step waiting for done (ship-change's conduct, until_when = done) can pass, and anything closing done sessions can close it, before the session has worked the hand-back. The plan clears the done mark when a hand-back messages a live session, before the message is typed, and leaves the resume path, the asked mark and the other status reports as they are.
fields.title: Plan of the rejoined conductor done-mark fix (autonomous plan run)
